headline: Reserve Bank of Australia Lifts Interest Rates to 18-Year High
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia raised its benchmark interest rate to 4.85%, marking an 18-year high following a split 6-3 decision.
why: Central bank interest rate decisions dictate domestic borrowing costs, mortgage rates, and currency valuations across the Australian financial system.

impacts.name: Australia
impacts.why: Higher interest rates increase borrowing costs and impact economic growth across the country.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A surprise or aggressive rate hike increases the cost of capital, tightening financial conditions and impacting mortgage holders and asset valuations.
